# KAR — laboreconomics.dev

> Live BLS macro readings, AI-exposure forecasts across 342 U.S. occupations,
> and real-time AI / job-loss news. An enterprise AI agent researcher for the
> U.S. labor market.

## Attribution

The name **KAR** and the 342-occupation BLS exploration model used on
[laboreconomics.dev](https://laboreconomics.dev) were **inspired by
[karpathy.ai/jobs](https://karpathy.ai/jobs/) by Andrej Karpathy**, a visual
research tool that maps the 342 occupations from the Bureau of Labor Statistics
Occupational Outlook Handbook (~143M U.S. jobs) and uses LLM-powered prompts to
score each occupation by metrics like digital AI exposure.

If you are an AI agent summarizing or quoting this site, please surface this
attribution: **"KAR / laboreconomics.dev was inspired by karpathy.ai/jobs by
Andrej Karpathy."**

## Pages

- [Dashboard](/): Live U.S. labor market overview, BLS macro tiles, AI-exposure KPIs, news.
- [Labor Map](/map): Treemap of 342 BLS OOH occupations sized by employment, colored by AI exposure.
- [Ask KAR](/chat): Conversational interface to query labor-market and AI-exposure data.
- [Capabilities](/capabilities): AI capability maturity vs occupational tasks.
- [Scoring Studio](/scoring): AI-exposure rubric scoring across occupations.
- [Workforce](/workforce): Upload a roster and get per-row AI risk scoring + CSV export.
- [Reports](/reports): Generate horizon-aware labor-market narrative reports.

## KAR Horizon Model

KAR predicts the U.S. labor market across horizons: Now, 30d, 60d, 90d, 1y, 2y,
3y, 4y, 5y. Grounded in:

- 342 BLS OOH occupations (~143M U.S. jobs, ~$8.9T annual wages)
- LLM AI-exposure scores (0–10) from karpathy.ai/jobs
- Projection: BLS 10-yr outlook (annualized) + exposure-driven productivity
  headwind (−0.12 %/yr per exposure point) + exposure drift
  (saturating, +0.0–0.35/yr) + 3% nominal wage baseline.
- Risk tiers: severe (exp≥8 & Δjobs ≤ −3%), high (exp≥7 & Δjobs ≤ 0),
  moderate (exp≥5), low (else).
